items.title: Daily X Report — 2026-11-27
items.detail:
Thanksgiving-week rebound and a historic precious-metals surge lead the day: S&P 500 futures topped 7,300 for the first time since November 19, the Nasdaq 100 rose 2.5% in the week, gold jumped over 4% and silver over 10% in a single day, and Anthropic is reportedly in talks for an IPO as early as 2026. In AI, the GPT-6.2 preprint and Astra astronomy finds show models landing in real research, Mistral matches closed models on visual grounding and transcription, and NVIDIA Blackwell hardware showed up in a Shanghai data center.

1. GPT-6.2 preprint: a lab in your pocket
OpenAI published a GPT-6.2 preprint with a protein-design proof of concept, pitching the model as able to do world-class research and run experiments.
Link: https://x.com/OpenAI/status/2125334383490105601

2. Amateur astronomers discover new celestial objects with Astra
Amateur astronomers used Astra, Codex's research assistant, to discover and catalogue new celestial objects, including an exoplanet host star.
Link: https://x.com/OpenAI/status/2125305606685053416

3. Mistral Large 4 beats closed frontier models at visual grounding
Mistral Large 4 can pinpoint and box targets on a map, outperforming closed frontier models on visual grounding.
Link: https://x.com/MistralAI/status/2125915743212761359

4. Five Mistral models in the top 40 for transcription accuracy
Mistral says five of its models rank in the Artificial Analysis top 40 for transcription accuracy, highlighting Voxtral's speech transcription.
Link: https://x.com/MistralAI/status/2126292459265442028

5. Neon sets a day-one record for paid API usage
Sundar Pichai says Neon set a day-one record for paid API usage, with daily tokens up 82% since Argon launched six weeks ago.
Link: https://x.com/sundarpichai/status/2125311868168515603

6. NVIDIA open-sources VLA model Alpamayo
Alpamayo is NVIDIA's open inference vision-language-action model ecosystem for autonomous driving and robotaxis, with simulation tools and datasets.
Link: https://x.com/nvidia/status/2125620592174838027

7. Everyday agents can plan ads: Runway MCP access
Runway says plugging an agent into Runway is like giving it a creative studio, and shared the MCP access route.
Link: https://x.com/runwayml/status/2125246332642427088

8. S&P 500 futures top 7,300 for the first time since Nov 19
S&P 500 futures topped 7,300 for the first time since November 19, with markets pricing a greater than 60% chance of a December rate cut.
Link: https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2126165560002015515

9. Gold up over 4%, silver up over 10% in a historic single day
After reclaiming $3,600 in the morning, gold rose over 4% and silver over 10% on the day, a historic single-day surge for precious metals.
Link: https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2126274285538832812

10. Nasdaq 100 up 2.5% in Thanksgiving week, breadth beats the index
The Nasdaq 100 rose 2.5% in Thanksgiving week, but its average constituent rose 3.6%, so breadth, not a few heavyweights, drove the gain.
Link: https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2126147641423937581

11. Anthropic in IPO talks, earliest listing in 2026
Per CNBC, Anthropic is in talks to go public as early as 2026, potentially one of the largest IPOs ever and the first listed major AI lab.
Link: https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2125645220524286373

12. Chinese firms install NVIDIA Blackwell in a Shanghai data center
Two Chinese companies installed NVIDIA Blackwell AI chipsets in a Shanghai data center despite US export controls on advanced chips.
Link: https://x.com/business/status/2126282417560232189
items.detailZh:
今日推特精选报告（2026-11-27）

总览：今日主线是感恩节周的反弹与贵金属的历史性大涨。标普 500 期货自 11 月 19 日以来首次站上 7300 点、纳指感恩节周涨 2.5%，黄金单日涨超 4%、白银涨超 10%；Anthropic 传正商谈最早 2026 年 IPO。AI 一侧，GPT-6.2 预印本与 Astra 天文发现展示模型科研落地，Mistral 在视觉定位与语音转录上对标闭源；芯片地缘上，英伟达 Blackwell 现身上海数据中心。

一、AI 实用 / Agent

1. GPT-6.2 预印本：口袋里的实验室
OpenAI 发布 GPT-6.2 预印本，定位为“口袋里的实验室”，给出蛋白质设计概念验证，称模型能做世界级研究并执行实验。适合跟踪新模型科研能力的实际证据。
链接：https://x.com/OpenAI/status/2125334383490105601

2. 业余天文学家用 Astra 发现新天体
业余天文学家用 Astra（Codex 的研究助手）发现并编目新天体，案例包括发现系外行星宿主恒星与搭建凌星筛查工具。是 Agent 在真实科研中落地的生动例子。
链接：https://x.com/OpenAI/status/2125305606685053416

3. Mistral Large 4 视觉定位胜过闭源前沿模型
Mistral Large 4 能在地图上精确定位并框出目标，视觉定位任务上胜过闭源前沿模型。是开源模型在视觉理解这一实用能力上对标闭源的直接证据。
链接：https://x.com/MistralAI/status/2125915743212761359

4. Mistral 五个模型进语音转录准确率前 40
Mistral 称其有 5 个模型进入 Artificial Analysis 转录准确率前 40 名，突出 Voxtral 的语音转录表现。是开源模型在语音转录上对标的又一直接证据。
链接：https://x.com/MistralAI/status/2126292459265442028

二、AI 视频 / 世界模型

5. Neon 上线首日付费 API 使用量创纪录
Sundar Pichai 称 Neon 上线首日付费 API 使用量创纪录，自六周前 Argon 发布以来每日 token 量增长 82%。是衡量 Gemini 4 实际需求的硬数据。
链接：https://x.com/sundarpichai/status/2125311868168515603

6. 英伟达开源 VLA 模型 Alpamayo
Alpamayo 是英伟达面向自动驾驶与机器人出租车的开源推理视觉-语言-动作模型生态，含仿真工具与数据集。是世界模型/VLA 落地自动驾驶的官方发布。
链接：https://x.com/nvidia/status/2125620592174838027

7. 日常 Agent 也能策划广告：Runway MCP 接入
Runway 提出“日常 Agent 也能策划广告，接入 Runway 就等于给 Agent 配了一个创意工作室”，并给出 MCP 接入方式。是 Agent×视频生成结合的实用信号。
链接：https://x.com/runwayml/status/2125246332642427088

三、金融与市场

8. 标普 500 期货自 11 月 19 日以来首次站上 7300 点
标普 500 期货自 11 月 19 日以来首次站上 7300 点，市场计入 12 月降息概率超 60%，指数距历史高点仅 -3.7%。是感恩节周美股反弹的核心数据点。
链接：https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2126165560002015515

9. 黄金涨超 4%、白银涨超 10%，创历史性一日涨幅
继上午重回 3600 美元后，黄金全日涨超 4%、白银涨超 10%，贵金属正创下历史性一日涨幅。是贵金属同日大涨的标志性数据。
链接：https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2126274285538832812

10. 纳指 100 感恩节周涨 2.5%，个股跑赢指数
纳指 100 感恩节周涨 2.5%，但成分股平均涨 3.6%，个股跑赢指数 1.1 个百分点。揭示涨幅由个股扩散而非少数权重股驱动。
链接：https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2126147641423937581

11. Anthropic 正商谈上市，最早 2026 年 IPO
据 CNBC，Anthropic 正商谈上市，最早 2026 年 IPO，或成史上最大 IPO 之一、首家上市的大型 AI 实验室。是 AI 与市场交叉的重磅消息。
链接：https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2125645220524286373

12. 中国公司在上海数据中心安装英伟达 Blackwell
两家中国公司在上海一座数据中心安装了英伟达 Blackwell AI 芯片组，尽管美国对先进芯片实施出口管制。是 AI 算力与出口管制交叉的最新消息。
链接：https://x.com/business/status/2126282417560232189

附注：x.com 全天被 403 拦截，本报告全部内容经 TwStalker 镜像（twstalker.com）读取，状态 ID 逐条从镜像详情页原样复制，未能在 x.com 直接打开验证。@OpenAI、@AnthropicAI、@GoogleDeepMind、@nvidia、@perplexity_ai 今日无新帖；@runwayml 今日仅一条 04:00 转推，无原创帖。今日池共 34 条，本报告入选 12 条；入选条目均未在昨日（2026-11-26）报告中出现。
